documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Goldiam International reported strong growth momentum in Q1 FY27 with total revenue of INR3,637 million and EBITDA growing by 120% to INR1,039 million. Steady-state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%, while lab-grown diamond jewelry exports contributed 90.7% to the overall export sales mix. The company's order book position as on June 30, 2026, stood at approximately INR2,250 million. Additionally, ORIGEM, the India-focused B2B lab-grown diamond jewelry retail brand, had 26 operational stores and recorded a total revenue of INR81.56 million for the quarter. Goldiam International reported record performance in Q1 FY27, with total income growing 54% year-on-year to ₹3,637 million and PAT doubling to ₹740 million.

guidance.claim: The company expects and targets positive double-digit overall growth for the fiscal year 2027.
guidance.quote: We hope for and we are looking forward to build towards a very positive growth, double-digit growth in FY '27 on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: Management targets an exit revenue of about INR 7 crores per month for the ORIGEM business by the end of fiscal year 2027.
guidance.quote: So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business.

guidance.claim: The company targets having 45 to 50 COCO stores for the ORIGEM brand by the exit of fiscal year 2027.
guidance.quote: So we may have a quarter where we decide to focus on enhancing revenues from existing stores. But by exit FY '27, the ideal goal is to be in the range of 45 to 50 COCO stores.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects a robust Q2 and Q3 compared to the already record FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: We are looking forward to a robust Q2, Q3 compared to already record FY26, and we hope to continue the growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Wholesale prices of lab-grown diamonds have reached a base and have moved upwards for certain smaller sizes.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, in this quarter, we have even seen prices move upwards for certain sizes, especially the smaller sizes of lab-grown diamonds.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand scenario continues to remain positive, specifically within the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space.
demand_outlook.quote: So yes, the demand scenario continues to look positive, specifically in the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space.

demand_outlook.claim: Retailers are moving down in gold karatage in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs and maintain end-customer price points.
demand_outlook.quote: In general, we see our retailers in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs, specifically in gold, moving down in Kt.

demand_outlook.claim: Bridal jewelry accounts for approximately 50% of the U.S. jewelry market, while fashion jewelry accounts for the other 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: It's -- so in general, for the U.S. jewelry industry, bridal jewelry is about 50% of the market and fashion jewelry is about 50% of the market.

capex_expansion.claim: ORIGEM now operates 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: ORIGEM, Goldiam’s India retail lab grown diamond jewellery brand, now operates 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: From January 2026 to the time of the call, ORIGEM doubled its store count and now operates 24 stores across 12 cities.
capex_expansion.quote: From January 2026 till now, ORIGEM, Goldiam's India retail lab-grown diamond jewelry brand has doubled its store count, now having 24 operational stores across 12 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: There are 8 to 10 additional ORIGEM stores scheduled to become operational by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cash outflow required to open a single ORIGEM store is approximately INR 3.5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So all in, if you add these 3 buckets up, the total expense to open an ORIGEM store or cash out to open an ORIGEM store is about INR3.5 crores, give or take a certain amount.

margins_costs.claim: Steady state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%.
margins_costs.quote: Steady state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%.

margins_costs.claim: Out of the other income described, approximately INR22 crores came from tariff duty refund.
margins_costs.quote: Regarding Q1 itself, out of the other income described, INR22 crores approximately has come from tariff refund, tariff duty refund.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects an incremental gross margin impact of between 200 to 300 basis points on a full year basis due to the U.S. hybrid casting model.
margins_costs.quote: It's about between 200 to 300 basis point increment that we are expecting on a full year basis.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half of fiscal 2027, the company expects to spend between INR 4 crores to INR 4.5 crores on marketing expenses.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half of fiscal 2027, we are looking forward to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expense.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026, was about INR2,250 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about INR2,250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam has 26 operational stores under the brand name ORIGEM across key cities.
orders_capacity.quote: As on date, Goldiam has 26 operational stores under the brand name ORIGEM across key cities.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book is expected to be executed in the next three to four months.
orders_capacity.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as of March 31, 2026, was approximately INR 2,000 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on March 31, 2026, was at about INR2,000 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Eco-Friendly Diamonds LLP operates about 30 machines within its facility in the Special Economic Zone.
orders_capacity.quote: So we have about 30 machines within the facility in SEZ that are operating nonstop.

orders_capacity.claim: In-house lab-grown diamond production accounts for approximately 10% of Goldiam's overall consumption.
orders_capacity.quote: To share today, Eco-Friendly production is perhaps less -- is about 10% of Goldiam's overall consumption of lab-grown diamonds.

capital_allocation.claim: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares of INR2 each as fully paid up bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1:3.
capital_allocation.quote: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares of INR2 each as fully paid up bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1:3 by utilizing an amount of INR7,52,78,562.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents including investments were at ₹4566.71 million as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and Cash Equivalents (including investments) were at ₹ 4566.71 million as at June, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Over the last five years, the company has distributed over ₹2.5 billion to shareholders via buyback and dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: ~₹2.5+bn distributed to shareholders via buyback and dividend over last 5 years

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a bonus share issue in the ratio of 1:3, offering one fully paid-up equity share of INR 2 for every three existing fully paid-up equity shares.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share in the ratio 1:3 fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each in proportion of new fully paid up equity share of INR2 for every 3 existing fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each, subject to the approval of shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments, stood at INR 4,933.92 million as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments were at INR4,933.92 million as on March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The increase in customs duty on gold to 15% shall not have any material impact on operations, financial performance, or profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: The recent increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15%, comprising 10% Basic Customs Duty (BCD) and 5% cess, we would like to inform you that the said increase shall not have any material impact on the operations, financial performance, or profitability of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management explicitly stated that Goldiam is tariff-agnostic and that the recent increase in custom duty on gold in India to 15% will not have a material impact on operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Here, I would like you to note that Goldiam is tariff agnostic and the recent increase in custom duty in India on gold to 15% will not have any material impact on Goldiam's operations, financial performance or profitability.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they hope to report double-digit growth in non-American areas by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So we hope to increase that number in a good way by the end of the year. So we'll be able to report to you that we'll have a double-digit growth in non-American areas as well.

management_commitments.claim: FY27 will most likely be a full financial year where the dual casting method will be employed throughout the year.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 will be most likely a full financial year where this dual casting method will be employed throughout the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to have between 45 to 50 COCO stores for the ORIGEM brand by the exit of fiscal year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we may have a quarter where we decide to focus on enhancing revenues from existing stores. But by exit FY '27, the ideal goal is to be in the range of 45 to 50 COCO stores.

management_commitments.claim: ORIGEM targets an exit revenue run rate of about INR 7 crores per month by the end of fiscal year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to spend between INR 4 crores and INR 4.5 crores on marketing expenses during the first half of fiscal year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: For the first half of fiscal 2027, we are looking forward to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expense.

management_commitments.claim: An additional 8 to 10 ORIGEM stores are planned to become operational by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.
